verdict.rationale: Fellow's first-party MCP server lets users ask their AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) natural-language questions about meetings, such as "What were my action items this week?", without writing code. An "Ask Fellow" feature is also listed on the pricing page. The documented natural-language use is query and retrieval; there is no evidence that natural-language commands can perform actions in the product. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can take actions (e.g., complete action items, edit agendas, control recording), detail on the in-product "Ask Fellow" assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
